summary: Native Android release 0.5.16 (versionCode 18): phone chats load history in pages and keep their saved copy after a clean reconnect, live messages show during a refresh, a long background absence reconnects again and an IAP tunnel to an older host is handed to connect() (phone-thread-load.json); the dead phone code removed in #248 also ships here.

desktop.reason: Android version bump; desktop parts are covered by phone-thread-load.json.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own lane; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The windowed history request is covered by phone-thread-load.json.

notExercised: Installing the update on a physical device through the in-app updater.
